output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_eur
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: This query adds up discount_amount (gross amount minus net revenue, in EUR) for every completed order placed in calendar year 2025. Your fiscal year is the calendar year. "Completed" uses the is_revenue = true flag, which means status = 'completed'. The total is rounded to 2 decimals.
